intro.h2: A real cabinet shop, not a showroom middleman
paragraphs: Uxbridge Cabinet Center makes kitchen cabinets in Uxbridge from its own shop on Quaker Hwy, where the crew builds, sands, sprays and stains the boxes and doors. The same team designs the kitchen, installs it and can cut and install quartz countertops too.

Customers notice the small things. One had the shop retrofit a cabinet for a new range top, and the installers made sure every jar that fit in the old drawers fit again afterward. Reviewers name Jeff for design and service, and Jim and Chuck for careful, patient installs. Two of these reviewers came back to the shop for a second project.

services.h2: Cabinets and countertops from our Uxbridge shop

items.name: Kitchen design and cabinets
items.blurb: Full kitchens designed and built to fit your room, from painted white shaker to stained wood and two-tone mixes. One recent kitchen paired White Dove painted cabinets with white oak cabinets in a 10% white stain.

image.alt: Gray painted kitchen with island, glass-front upper cabinets, stainless range hood and wood-look floor

items.name: Bathroom vanities and cabinets
items.blurb: Vanities and bathroom storage built in the same shop as your kitchen, so finishes can match from room to room. One customer chose white painted uppers and black stained lowers for her kitchen and her bathroom.

image.alt: Tall painted gray pantry cabinets with brushed nickel pulls beside a dining area

items.name: Custom built-ins, mudrooms and bars
items.blurb: Built-ins for living rooms, offices, mudrooms and laundry rooms, plus coffee bars with glass-front uppers. A recent customer came back after her kitchen for custom built-ins around her stone fireplace and called the result amazing.

image.alt: Black built-in bookcases and lower cabinets on both sides of a stone fireplace in a living room

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: The shop can cut and install quartz countertops as part of your cabinet job. A Google reviewer said this made the project seamless: her kitchen was designed, the tops were cut and installed, and the install was fast and well done.

image.alt: Kitchen island with honed white and gray stone-look countertop and dark cabinet base

items.name: Retrofits and custom panels
items.blurb: Smaller jobs count too. The crew has retrofitted a base cabinet for a new range top, made all the minute adjustments to the drawers, and later added a custom panel to the same customer's new dishwasher.

image.alt: Cream kitchen cabinets with arched range hood surround, diamond tile backsplash and granite counters

why_choose_us.h2: Why Uxbridge homeowners choose this shop

items.title: Built here, installed by the builders
items.text: The shop hires for every phase: cabinet building, installing, sanding, spraying and staining. The people who know your cabinets best are the ones who set them.

items.title: Quotes from real measurements
items.text: "They got all the specs before they gave me the quote," one reviewer wrote. You get a price for your actual room, not a guess.

items.title: Installers people remember
items.text: Jim and Chuck come up again and again in reviews. Customers call them professional, polite and patient, and say they go the extra mile on the small adjustments.

items.title: Workmanship and fair pricing
items.text: Workmanship is the most mentioned topic in their Google reviews after cabinets. Google's summary quotes one customer: "Excellent workmanship, honest, well priced, good natured Jeff."

about.h2: Owned by JR Edick and Jeffrey King
about.text: Uxbridge Cabinet Center is a cabinet shop at 706 Quaker Hwy in Uxbridge, Massachusetts, owned and operated by JR Edick and Jeffrey King. The crew builds cabinets in-house and handles the sanding, spraying, staining and installing themselves. Customers know Jeff for design and service, and installers Jim and Chuck for patient, careful work. Kitchens are the core of the business, along with bathrooms, built-ins, mudrooms, coffee bars and quartz countertops. Stop by the black building with the big sign on Quaker Hwy on a weekday.

image.alt: Uxbridge Cabinet Center shop building on Quaker Hwy with a large sign on the dark metal facade

process.h2: From first visit to final adjustment

steps.title: Visit or call
steps.text: Call (508) 278-6551 or stop by the shop on Quaker Hwy, Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4 PM.

steps.title: Measure and quote
steps.text: The team gets all the specs for your room first, then gives you a quote based on what they measured.

steps.title: Design your kitchen
steps.text: Pick door styles, paint or stain colors and layout with the designer, including countertops if you want quartz cut and installed too.

steps.title: Build and finish
steps.text: Your cabinets are built, then sanded, sprayed or stained by the crew in the Uxbridge shop before delivery.

steps.title: Install and adjust
steps.text: The installers set the cabinets and make the small adjustments until doors, drawers and panels fit the way you need them to.

items.name: Durjay N.
items.text:
They have just retrofitted my cabinet for a new range top I am installing. These guys are professionals that I would trust with my eyes closed. They got all the specs before they gave me the quote. Jim and Chuck, guys who did the actual work are the nicest people you'll find - professional, polite and patient. They made sure all the jars, that I had in the drawers before fit perfectly after the job was done and they did all the minute adjustments needed. I would highly recommend them.
I did more work with them later to add a custom panel to my new dishwasher. Quality of their workmanship and service is as great as before.They always go the extra mile to meet your needs. I would highly, highly recommend them.

items.name: Karla B.
items.text: UXBRIDGE Cabinets did such a beautiful job creating an amazing kitchen for us! They were so thorough, helpful and wonderful to work with. It was so seamless that we were able to not only have our kitchen designed but they also cut and installed our quartz countertops. One stop for all our needs. The installation was fast and well done.  They delivered everything that they had promised. I couldn’t recommend them enough.

service_area.text: Uxbridge Cabinet Center works from its shop at 706 Quaker Hwy in Uxbridge, Massachusetts, and Uxbridge is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you are planning a kitchen, bathroom or built-in project in or around Uxbridge, call (508) 278-6551 or stop by the shop during the week to ask whether your home is in their install area.

items.q: Do you build the cabinets yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Uxbridge Cabinet Center is a cabinet shop, and its own job posts list every phase of the work: cabinet building, installing, sanding, spraying and staining. Your cabinets are made and finished by the same company that installs them in your home.

items.q: Can you do the countertops too?
items.a: Yes. A Google reviewer said the shop designed her kitchen and also cut and installed her quartz countertops, which made the whole job seamless. Ask about countertop options when you come in to plan your cabinets, so both are priced together.

items.q: Do you take on small jobs?
items.a: Yes. One customer had a cabinet retrofitted for a new range top, with the drawers adjusted so everything fit as before, and later had a custom panel added to a new dishwasher. Call (508) 278-6551 and describe what you need.

The shop is open Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 4 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can also email uxbcabctr@aol.com with photos or measurements of your space and the team will follow up during business hours.

The shop is at 706 Quaker Hwy, Uxbridge, MA 01569, in the dark building with the large Uxbridge Cabinet Center sign. If you live outside Uxbridge, call and ask whether your town is in their install area before you plan a visit.
